members.name: items
members.doc: The tabs as data: strings, or items with an `id`, a `label`, a `textValue`, `disabled`, and the `panel` the tab shows.

members.name: value
members.doc: The id of the selected tab, when the caller controls the selection.

members.name: defaultValue
members.doc: The id of the tab selected at first, when Tabs controls its own selection. Without one, the first enabled tab is selected.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Disables every tab. A tab's own `disabled` disables just that tab.

members.name: orientation
members.doc: The direction the tabs run, which arrow keys follow.

members.name: keyboardActivation
members.doc: How arrow keys act. With `automatic`, an arrow key selects the tab it reaches. With `manual`, arrow keys only move focus, and Enter or Space selects the focused tab.

members.name: size
members.doc: The control size, sm, md, or lg.

members.name: variant
members.doc: The visual treatment of the tab list: underline, pill, overflow, or segment.

members.name: onChange
members.doc: Called with the id of the tab the user selects. It is not called for a disabled tab or while Tabs is disabled.

types.name: MuxUICollectionItem

members.name: value
members.doc: Consumer data; named Select and ComboBox forms submit the item `id`, not `value`.
